# Zed Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Zed configuration. The main output is `AGENTS.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - zed
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - zed:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property          | Value       |
| ----------------- | ----------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3      |
| **Main output**   | `AGENTS.md` |
| **Dot directory** | `.zed/`     |
| **Skills**        | No          |
| **Agents**        | No          |
| **Commands**      | No          |
| **Local files**   | No          |

## Output Files

| File              | Path        | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `AGENTS.md` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                         |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `simple`         | Single AGENTS.md file          |
| `multifile`      | AGENTS.md + .zed/settings.json |
| `full` (default) | AGENTS.md + .zed/settings.json |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                     |
| ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | `.zed/settings.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported               |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
